description:
Return a citation for one archive document (dc_…) or one HTTP RFC clause (rfc…): citation line, BibTeX, original URL, license, SHA-256 or official RFC text, and a stable public web page (no JavaScript) that anyone can open to check it. Nothing is written or recorded.
When to use: Step 3 of search → read → cite: call it with the id you relied on, and put its citation (or page_url) in your answer. text_reuse tells you whether the document's license allows quoting its text beyond a short excerpt.
Notes: No account or token needed. It does not need a mandate (unlike cite_document, which records a citation in the city ledger).
Example arguments: {"id":"rfc9111-s5.2.2.2-c2"}

id.description: A document id from search_archive (dc_ + 12 hex) or a clause id from search_clauses (e.g. rfc9110-s13.1.3-c1).

name: cite_source
title: Get a ready citation and stable link for a source or RFC clause
